greeting: Namaste! Welcome to Swanirvar. I am your business elder Saathi.
hero_title: From Local Village Evidence to a Bank-Ready Business
hero_subtitle: Evaluate customer demand, competitor saturation, APMC mandi rates, and 40-page bank loan viability in your own voice.
voice_search_placeholder: Ask in your language: 'Dukan check karo' or 'Chini ka mandi bhav'...

how_it_works.step1: Pinpoint your village, haat or district centroid.
how_it_works.step2: Scan real-time competitors, mandis, and supply chains via GIS.
how_it_works.step3: Simulate customer footfall and seasonal monsoon cashflow dips.
how_it_works.step4: Audit KYC documents and check PMEGP / Mudra subsidy match.
how_it_works.step5: Download certified bank-ready Detailed Project Report (DPR).
